plainLanguage: Section 41 inafanya misprision of treason kuwa offence kwa kuwa accessory after the fact to treason/treasonable offence, au kwa kujua nia ya mtu kufanya offence hiyo na kutotoa taarifa kwa haraka inayofaa au kutumia juhudi nyingine za kuizuia.
meaning: The provision contains alternative routes to liability: post-offence assistance as an accessory after the fact, or knowing of an intended treason/treasonable offence and failing to take the specified reasonable steps. The section states life imprisonment on conviction.
keyPoints: Paragraph (a) concerns being an accessory after the fact.
Paragraph (b) requires knowledge of another person's intended treason or treasonable offence.
Paragraph (b) refers to information given with all reasonable dispatch to specified public officers, or other reasonable endeavours to prevent the offence.
Penalty stated is imprisonment for life.

legalTerms.meaning: Mtu anayehusika baada ya offence kwa namna inayotambuliwa na criminal law.
Kutoa taarifa kwa haraka inayofaa kwa mazingira, si kuchelewesha bila sababu.

examples.title: Knowledge and response
examples.scenario: Mtu anapata taarifa ya mpango unaodaiwa kuwa treasonable lakini anachukua hatua za haraka kumjulisha police officer.
examples.analysis: Whether section 41(b) is satisfied depends on proof of knowledge and whether the statutory reporting/prevention obligation was met.

history.summary: Section 41 follows the treason and treasonable-offence provisions and criminalises specified post-offence assistance or failure to act on known intended treason.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: Actual statutory knowledge is central to paragraph (b); mere suspicion should not automatically be equated with it.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: The provision itself uses reasonableness language, making the circumstances of reporting or prevention relevant.

debateQuestion: Evidence inaonyesha knowledge gani, na hatua zilizochukuliwa au kutokuchukuliwa zinakidhi vipi 'reasonable dispatch' au 'reasonable endeavours'?
disclaimer: Ufafanuzi huu si maandishi rasmi ya sheria.
